result.evidence_quote: we aimed to investigate the potential pro-inflammatory effects of sterile fecal microbiome filtrate (FMF) using a microphysiological, immunocompetent intestine-on-chip (IoC) model.
result.rationale: The study investigates microbiome-derived inflammation and intestinal barrier damage in ulcerative colitis. Its vascular compartment and endothelial measurements serve the intestinal model; it does not investigate cardiovascular disease, risk prediction, prevention, or cardiovascular therapies or outcomes.
